title: Questions we get asked
intro: Delivery, payment, returns and the practical details. If your question isn't here, ring the store.

items.question: Do you deliver, and how far?
items.answer: Yes — within 8 km of the store. Orders placed before 6 pm are delivered the same evening; anything later goes out the next morning. Delivery is free above ₹499 and ₹39 below that.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Call or WhatsApp us with your list, or build one using the Shopping Planner on this site and send it across. We confirm the total before we pack.

items.question: Can I change an order after placing it?
items.answer: Until it has been packed, yes. Ring the store rather than sending a message — once a delivery run leaves we cannot alter it.

items.question: What if something I ordered is out of stock?
items.answer: We call and ask before substituting anything. We will never swap a brand or a size without checking with you first.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: Cash, UPI, and all major debit and credit cards in store. For deliveries, UPI on confirmation or cash on delivery.

items.question: Are the prices on this site current?
items.answer: They are updated weekly. Fresh produce moves with the market, so the price at the counter can differ slightly — we will always tell you before billing.

items.question: Do you price match?
items.answer: Not formally. If you have seen something cheaper locally, tell us — on staples we can usually do something.

items.question: Can I return something?
items.answer: Unopened, non-perishable items within 7 days with the bill. Fresh produce, dairy and bakery cannot be returned once they have left the store, for food safety reasons.

items.question: What if produce arrives in poor condition?
items.answer: Tell us the same day and we replace it or refund it, no questions asked. Send a photo on WhatsApp if it is easier than coming in.

items.question: How fresh is the fresh produce, really?
items.answer: Fruit and vegetables are delivered to us each morning from growers within the district. Anything unsold after two days is marked down, and after three it comes off the shelf.

items.question: What are your opening hours?
items.answer: Monday to Saturday, 7:00 am to 9:30 pm. Sunday, 8:00 am to 8:00 pm. We open on all public holidays except Sankranti.

items.question: Is there parking?
items.answer: Yes, free customer parking for about 20 vehicles behind the store, accessed from the side lane.

items.question: Do you make up festival hampers?
items.answer: We do, from ₹899, built to order from our dry fruits, sweets and gifting range. Give us three days' notice for larger orders.

items.question: Can you break bulk packs?
items.answer: For most staples, yes. If you want two kilos out of a five kilo bag of rice or dal, ask at the counter.
